import json,pickle,sys,numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0,'/holdout_task')
from _verified_upstream import calibrate_upstream
from downstream_solver import _features,_gap,solve_downst

reusable_ast_function_closures.code:
def _features(train, test):
    x = np.vstack([train['coupon_features_raw'], test['coupon_features_raw']]).copy()
    ref = np.vstack([train['ref_coupons'], test['ref_coupons']])
    lab = np.r_[train['lab_id'], test['lab_id']]
    stratum = np.r_[train['stratum'], test['stratum']]
    for l in np.unique(lab):
        m = lab == l
        r = ref[m]
        x[m] = (x[m] - np.median(r.mean(axis=0))) / np.median(r.std(axis=0, ddof=0))
    cells = np.column_stack((lab, stratum))
    (_, inv, counts) = np.unique(cells, axis=0, return_inverse=True, return_counts=True)
    w = 1.0 / counts[inv]
    obs = np.isfinite(x)
    center = np.nansum(x * w[:, None], axis=0) / (obs.T @ w)
    x = np.where(obs, x, center)
    n = len(train['lab_id'])
    return (x[:n], x[n:])

def _loads(part, bridge):
    return (part['past_channel_raw'] @ bridge[1:] + bridge[0], part['hold_channel_raw'] @ bridge[1:] + bridge[0])

reusable_ast_function_closures.code:
def _design(tau, x, p, h, dt, t):
    age = np.cumsum(dt[::-1])[::-1] - dt
    z = p @ (np.exp(-age[:, None] / tau) * -np.expm1(-dt[:, None] / tau))
    gap = h[:, None] - z
    drift = np.column_stack((np.ones(len(x)), x))
    curves = np.concatenate((gap[:, None, :] * -np.expm1(-t[:, None] / tau), t[None, :, None] * drift[:, None, :]), axis=2)
    rate = np.column_stack((gap / tau, drift))
    return (curves, rate)

def _chamber(tau, beta, x, hold, t):
    drift = beta[2] + x @ beta[3:]
    offset = np.array([-0.005718918, 0.048043863, -0.004934461])
    gain = np.array([0.391080014, 1.804301785, 0.039087689])
    modes = offset + drift[:, None] * gain
    modes[:, :2] += hold[:, None] * beta[:2]
    kernel = np.column_stack((-np.expm1(-t[:, None] / tau), t))
    return (modes @ kernel.T, modes @ np.r_[1.0 / tau, 1.0])

def solve_batch(dataset):
    (train, test) = (dataset['train'], dataset['test'])
    (t, dt) = (np.asarray(dataset['eval_times']), np.asarray(dataset['past_dt']))
    (x, xt) = _features(train, test)
    bridge = _bridge(dataset['calibration_load_cells'])
    (p, h) = _loads(train, bridge)
    (tau, beta) = _fit(x, p, h, dt, t, train['strain_curves_obs'] - train['strain_0'][:, None], train['instant_rate_obs'])
    (_, hold) = _loads(test, bridge)
    (strain_delta, rate) = _chamber(tau, beta, xt, hold, t)
    return {'estimated_taus': tau, 'hereditary_weights': beta, 'predicted_strain': test['strain_0'][:, None] + strain_delta, 'initial_rate_pred': rate}

def solve_downstream(cal_item: dict) -> dict:
    (train, test) = (cal_item['train'], cal_item['test'])
    (t, dt) = (np.asarray(cal_item['eval_times']), np.asarray(cal_item['past_dt']))
    (x, xt) = _features(train, test)
    (p, h) = _loads(train)
    (tau, beta) = _fit(x, p, h, dt, t, train['strain_curves_obs'] - train['strain_0'][:, None], train['instant_rate_obs'])
    (p, h) = _loads(test)
    (strain, rate) = _chamber(tau, beta, xt, p, h, dt, t)
    return {'estimated_taus': tau, 'hereditary_weights': beta, 'predicted_strain': test['strain_0'][:, None] + strain, 'initial_rate_pred': rate}
